_comment: Spymaster registry config (docs/iteration-architecture.md step 2, codenames/spymasters/registry.py). Each entry names a Spymaster subclass (see SPYMASTER_CLASSES) and its constructor params. 'trained' marks whether this entry expects a trained artifact before it can be built -- true only for the clue policies, whose checkpoints come from their training scripts. 'roles' says which scripts pick an entry up without naming it: 'baseline' is the standard comparison set (both arenas), 'exploration' is only offered by scripts/pipeline/run_two_team_arena.py. A new entry omitting 'roles' defaults to ['baseline'], so it appears in the arenas automatically.

spymasters._comment: Clue search against the distilled listener (cache/listener_gbt.txt) scored by codenames/pl_reward.py, derived in docs/clue-selection-learned.tex. Two-stage: expected_words shortlists the clue pool with its Gaussian model (extract() is ~750us/clue, so scoring all 11,145 would be ~8.4s per turn), then the listener rescores the top `shortlist`. `sigma` tunes ONLY that shortlisting pass and has no effect on the final ranking -- it is set to 1.5 rather than the baseline's 2.5 because the sigma ladder found 1.5 the better value and the first stage's job is recall, not order. The listener is fitted to gpt-oss-120b, so evaluating against Sonnet is a transfer test, not a self-evaluation.
spymasters.name: learned_listener

spymasters._comment: The learned listener retrained with free-association counts (cache/listener_gbt_assoc_w0.3.txt), which give its scores an absolute level, plus a pass priced on that level: a fixed outside option at the score of a word named in `pass_rate` of association lists (codenames/spymasters/association_listener.py). pass_rate=null switches the pass off. Not swept; docs/versions/association_listener.md.
spymasters.name: association_listener

spymasters._comment: A clue policy (codenames/clue_policy.py): one network maps a board to pi(clue | board) over the incumbent's pool from raw clue-word evidence and roles, and an outcome head picks the number. These weights (cache/policy_imitation.pt) imitate the incumbent's picks and values on training boards; it is the control for gptoss_reward_policy, which starts from them. docs/versions/imitation_policy.md.
spymasters.name: imitation_policy

spymasters._comment: imitation_policy fine-tuned by REINFORCE on the reward gpt-oss-120b's guesses (temperature 1) earn on the policy's own clues, with a KL penalty to the imitation policy (scripts/pipeline/train_reward_policy.py, cache/policy_gptoss_reward.pt). docs/versions/gptoss_reward_policy.md.
spymasters.name: gptoss_reward_policy

spymasters._comment: A clue policy with a k head (no cap at 4). It imitates the uncapped incumbent's picks, then is trained by actor-critic on full games against learned_listener with gpt-oss-120b guessing. The only reward is the game's result, scored by a critic V(board) = P(win) learned from those games (scripts/pipeline/train_win_actor_critic.py, cache/win_policy.pt). Nothing reads the listener's probabilities. docs/versions/win_actor_critic.md.
spymasters.name: win_actor_critic

spymasters._comment: Reference opponent, not a model of ours: Claude Sonnet 5 shown the board with roles and asked for a clue (codenames/spymasters/llm_spymaster.py). Role 'reference' is picked up by no script automatically -- every game it plays costs money, so it is only ever run by name (scripts/pipeline/run_eval_suite.py learned_listener sonnet_spymaster).
spymasters.name: sonnet_spymaster

spymasters._comment: learned_listener with the listener's confidence set per pick: at pick j the guesser picks from the words left by softmax(score / tau_j), tau = 1.0, 1.1, 1.3, 1.5 (pick 4's for later picks), fitted by maximum likelihood on the clean-holdout boards for cache/listener_gbt.txt. The frozen-score reward was calibrated at pick 1 and increasingly overconfident after it, so it overvalued clues whose later words are weak. The reward is computed exactly over which own words have been picked (codenames/spymasters/pick_temperature_listener.py). Everything else is learned_listener's. docs/versions/pick_temperature_listener.md.
spymasters.name: pick_temperature_listener

spymasters._comment: The incumbent's spymaster with a listener that knows 'is a kind of': three WordNet hypernym features (isa, isa_rev, isa_n; scripts/data/build_isa_sims.py) added to the current listener recipe (cache/listener_gbt_isa.txt). Aimed at category clues, where the incumbent's listener let associates (Pie for fruit, Moon for planet) take the members' probability. docs/versions/isa_listener.md.
spymasters.name: isa_listener

spymasters._comment: isa_listener plus ConceptNet 5.7: seven features for its typed relations (is-a both ways, part-whole, specific relations, any edge) and its phrase lexicon (clue and word form a phrase: Donald Duck, firefly); scripts/data/build_conceptnet_sims.py. Booster cache/listener_gbt_conceptnet.txt, same recipe and split. docs/versions/conceptnet_listener.md.
spymasters.name: conceptnet_listener

spymasters._comment: conceptnet_listener with the guesser's picks 2+ modelled as their own choices: at pick j the logits are alpha*s + beta*(max similarity to a word already picked), alpha = exp(a + b*(best score left - best score picked)), fitted on the stored rankings' later picks (codenames/sequential_listener.py, cache/sequential_listener.json). The reward is exact over which own words have been picked. docs/versions/within_turn_listener.md.
spymasters.name: within_turn_listener

spymasters._comment: conceptnet_listener plus gpt-oss's free associations as listener INPUTS: assoc_share (share of 5 lists per clue naming the word) and assoc_rank (mean 1/position); lists for the whole clue pool (collect_associations.py --pool, build_assoc_sims.py). Booster cache/listener_gbt_assoc_features.txt, same recipe and split. Not association_listener, which used such lists as a training target. docs/versions/assoc_feature_listener.md.
spymasters.name: assoc_feature_listener

spymasters._comment: assoc_feature_listener plus eleven more association features (codenames/assoc_profile.py, cache/assoc_profile.npz): the clue's profile (how vague its association lists are, its rarity, norms and WordNet senses) and the reverse direction (whether each board word's own lists name the clue). No new gpt-oss calls in play. Booster cache/listener_gbt_assoc_profile.txt (scripts/pipeline/train_profile_listener.py), same recipe and split. docs/versions/assoc_profile_listener.md.
spymasters.name: assoc_profile_listener

spymasters._comment: conceptnet_listener's listener with a new objective: the probability of winning after the turn, not expected words minus role costs. Each way the turn can end (the listener's distribution) leaves a score position, valued by V(a, b), the incumbent's win probability with a own and b opponent words left, estimated from 10,266 recorded gpt-oss games (scripts/data/build_win_value.py, cache/win_value.npz). No costs. `model_path` swaps the booster and `turn_model` (frozen | within_turn) the model of later picks, so listeners can be compared under one fixed objective. docs/versions/win_prob_listener.md.
spymasters.name: win_prob_listener

spymasters._comment: win_prob_listener with a V that reads the board: each ending of the turn is valued at the likeliest after-board for that clue, by V(a, b)'s logit plus a board correction (codenames/board_value.py) fitted on games with a listener-sampling guesser (scripts/pipeline/simulate_games.py, scripts/tools/eval_sim_value.py) and checked on 100k real gpt-oss states. board_value_path / board_counts_path swap the correction. docs/versions/board_value_listener.md.
spymasters.name: board_value_listener

spymasters._comment: win_prob_listener with a one-move lookahead: the best few (clue, number) pairs are re-valued by enumerating each turn's probable outcomes and working out the incumbent's reply on each after-board (its top clues from one search per move, re-scored with the revealed words dropped). An outcome's value is 1 - the incumbent's P(win) with that reply, instead of V's board-blind average. docs/versions/reply_lookahead_listener.md.
spymasters.name: reply_lookahead_listener

spymasters._comment: reply_lookahead_listener with the assoc booster and a pick-index model of our turn: the best 8 clues of the frozen search are scored at every number by cache/listener_gbt_pick_indexassoc_depth9.txt, which reads the assoc booster's features plus the pick number and pick number - k, so pick j of the turn is a softmax of its own scores (no post-hoc temperatures or within-turn layer). Each turn is enumerated exactly under those scores; the best 6 (clue, number) pairs get the incumbent's reply lookahead, centred on V by cache/reply_offset_pick_index.npz. docs/versions/pick_index_lookahead_listener.md.
spymasters.name: pick_index_lookahead_listener

spymasters._comment: win_prob_listener whose guesser can end its turn: the frozen search with the assoc profile booster picks the 200-clue shortlist, then every clue is re-valued at every number under cache/listener_gbt_stop.txt, a pick-index booster with a STOP row trained on gpt-oss's graded relatedness labels (the words a clue points at, asked without the number; scripts/pipeline/train_stop_listener.py). P(win) after the turn, exact over the found own words; STOP ends the turn like a neutral word. docs/versions/stop_listener.md.
spymasters.name: stop_listener
